about: The Translate Toolkit, tools and a Python API for converting and checking translation files.

prs.title: Backslashes no longer double on each CSV round trip
prs.broken: Converting translations to CSV and back doubled every backslash, and doubled it again each time, so changed strings stopped matching and showed as untranslated.
prs.changed: The CSV writer no longer adds an escape character the reader does not expect.
prs.matters: Translators can edit strings in a spreadsheet without breaking them.

prs.title: JSON files with numbers or true/false convert again
prs.broken: A single number or true/false value anywhere in a JSON translation file made the converter skip the whole file.
prs.changed: The converter now skips those values and keeps going, and puts them back when converting back.
prs.matters: Common app translation files can be used without editing them first.

prs.title: A test for PHP texts split across lines
prs.broken: PHP translation files that split one text over several lines with a join were read wrong, and the bug had no test to stop it coming back.
prs.changed: A test now checks that such a text reads as one string and is written back correctly.
prs.matters: The fix for these files stays fixed in future releases.

prs.title: YAML files with numbers or dates convert again
prs.broken: A single decimal number or date anywhere in a YAML translation file stopped the converter, and no translation file was made.
prs.changed: I made the converter skip those values and keep them as they are when writing back.
prs.matters: Locale files from Rails, Jekyll or Hugo can be translated without edits.
